title: New Conversation
summary: The user shared that they bought red and blue t-shirts at Aeon Mall today. They also inquired about recognizing scams and handling money requests from friends. Baymax highlighted common red flags like urgency, pressure tactics, and OTP requests. Regarding friends asking to borrow money, Baymax advised calling them directly or meeting in person to confirm their identity, as scammers often impersonate friends online. Baymax also recommended consulting family or Baymax before sharing private details or reacting to scary situations.
